skill.title: 🧩 The Micro Council skill
skill.intro: The same council, but directly in your agent: it composes the council, assembles the prompt and plays out the scene, no copy-pasting required.
skill.overviewBullet1: You ask for a council, and the agent offers three options: create a council step by step, load one you've already saved, or go automatic — it picks the members itself based on your topic.
skill.overviewBullet2: A small local script draws from the same catalog of companions and settings as this site, and produces exactly the same prompt.
skill.overviewBullet3: Every council you create is saved on your machine: the members, the setting, your instructions — but never the topic. Afterwards, just call it back by name, "run council ABC about…", to get it back exactly as it was.
skill.claudeCodeCommand: /microcouncil I'd like to talk about which show to watch next
skill.note: The `SKILL.md` format is shared by Hermes, Claude Code and agentskills.io: the `skill/` folder in the repository copies as-is into the skills directory of any other harness.
